Load-bearing: skip the credit write → payout 111.92 (vs 615.05); request signed for the signing date instead of the anchor → credit 341.49 (vs 406.88); skip the signature → no request to process (base signed-request eligibility) and no date. The phrase "the time since the HomeFlood plan started" is the customer's need, not a prerequisite. Closes at "the money is on its way back" = payout. Chain holds.
